notes: Aggregates only current members of the adopted fully taxable IRA-family. Source admission, exact box-1/box-2a equality, code-7 witness, checked combined IRA/SEP/SIMPLE checkbox, and explicit box-2b-not-determined false state occur before this rule. Present-source aggregation does not require, read, or pin closure authority; an empty family publishes zero only through a current literal-true closure admitted by the adopted mapping, and otherwise blocks. The result is Form 1040 line 4b; line 4a is intentionally not published. No IRA subtype selection, basis, rollover, Roth, or special-treatment logic is present. v4 adds a guard: the rule publishes only when the fully taxable IRA family (f1099r.ira-fully-taxable) is closed at the current horizon (require_closed). Why: collect reads closure only when its set is empty; with any member recorded it sums what is present and never asks whether the set is complete, so v3 published a partial line 4b when a family had a recorded amount and an unanswered or stale closure. With the guard, an unclosed family blocks this rule SOURCE_SET_UNCLOSED, naming the first unclosed set in the order listed, and every line that reads it waits. A complete return (every family closed at the current horizon, or closed empty) publishes exactly what v3 did. Residual, not closed here: a closure attested true over an amount that was never recorded still publishes the smaller sum, because the engine cannot tell a blank from 'nothing'.
